scope: Presentation-repository packaging, static gallery, publication workflow and portable documentation

axes.correctness: Manifest coverage, artifact hashes, relative links and anchors pass. Browser navigation, notes and PowerPoint download verified.
axes.readability: Small standalone Python publisher and checker; shared HTML/CSS wrapper; no runtime frontend dependencies.
axes.architecture: Application repository remains untouched. Pages deploys only the explicit static artifact set.
axes.security: Escaped text, bounded artifact paths, no symlinks in deployment. GitHub built-in token has only build read and deployment pages/id-token permissions. No personal deployment credentials. Local third-party tooling excluded.
axes.performance: 63.7 MB total static artifact set; previews are lazy-loaded; no client JavaScript or third-party requests.
axes.responsive: Gallery and viewer verified at 1440, 390 and 360 px with no document overflow.
axes.documentation: Repository visibility, Pages workflow, upstream attribution, source prerequisites and verification limitations are documented.

notApplicable: Nx application build/test and validate:docs targets do not apply to this independent static presentation repository. The source app and library files were not changed.
